llm.summary: This is a local note-board skill with a bundled HTML app; its main privacy caveat is a user-triggered online update check despite offline wording.

dimensions.detail: LocalStorage and IndexedDB use is proportionate for persisted notes, images, and user-selected files. The fixed ClawHub update request is not needed for core offline use, but it is only wired to explicit update-check clicks and does not send note contents.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The artifact contains a SKILL.md, a static HTML asset, and a reference document; no install-time executable script is bundled, though SKILL.md mentions an optional packaging command for distribution.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The invocation language is broad, including generic text collection and HTML-to-skill packaging requests; this could cause over-selection, but the runtime behavior remains aligned with the note-board app.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: Persistence is browser-local and disclosed for notes, drafts, trash, folders, images, and files. Delete, clear, restore, copy, download, and export actions are user-directed.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is a single-file front-end note, image, file-archive, and Word-export app, and the HTML implements those capabilities with browser storage, file selection, drag/drop, clipboard paste, and local downloads.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you want a browser-local note board that stores notes, images, and selected files in local browser storage. Be aware that clicking the version/check-update control contacts ClawHub for version metadata despite the offline wording; avoid that control if you want strictly no network activity.
llm.findings:
[SDI-1] unexpected: Confirmed a fetch to clawhub.ai for version metadata, while the documentation says the app does not network. The request appears manual via the update button/version click and does not include stored user content, so this is a disclosure caveat rather than a Review-level concern.
[SDI-2] unexpected: The online update check is not required for local note-taking or Word export, but it is limited to a fixed endpoint and explicit user action.
[SQP-1] unexpected: Confirmed the description includes broad routing text, including generic packaging use. This may cause misrouting, but it does not grant hidden authority or create automatic data exposure in the artifact.
[SQP-1] expected: The 'when to use' section broadly covers note-taking, excerpts, clipboard organization, and archiving, which matches the app's feature set but should be narrowed for cleaner activation.
